tweetMedia.transcription: Those tariffs are about his personal portfolio. I mean, what is the one thing every single foreign trip with Donald Trump has in common? He sends his envoys. Now, Wyckoff eventually gets there. He's part of it. But he sends the boys, sends the business partners to meet with the UAE first, to do the deal to make sure that Wyckoff and the Trump family have the $2 billion in world financial liberty. Establish that first. Then we can discuss the high value computer chips that we can approve in return. Your national security for their personal portfolio. Let's talk about what happened in Vietnam and the tariffs. They magically dropped 26 percent. But first, the government in Vietnam had to approve the one and a half billion dollar golf course and fast track the environmental work. All of these deals have a grift in common. Not about free enterprise anymore. It's crony capitalism. It's state capitalism. It's about the golden shares. And if you don't share, 10% of Intel, 25% AMD, NVIDIA, MP Materials. Look across the spectrum in all these things. The Trump tenure, Trump story is a story of corruption, of grift, the likes of which we've never experienced in modern American history.
